title: Exploiting Symmetry in Quantum Reservoir Computing
summary: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses a quantum processor without training it. The input is encoded into a quantum state, a fixed random circuit evolves it, selected observables are measured, and only a simple linear readout is trained on the measured values. We study QRC for forecasting on a ring of sensors, such as weather stations around a circle of latitude. On such a ring, the same physical rule governs every position, so a model that respects this symmetry can learn one shared local rule from all sensors at once instead of a separate rule per sensor.
